LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Exalted.stages.0.label: revered giant ant slain
LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Exalted.stages.0.descript: I killed one of the wasteland's most disciplined creatures. The colony will remember the loss even if nobody else does.
LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Despised.stages.0.label: giant ant exterminated
LanguageData.VME_Insectoids_Despised.stages.0.descrip: One less giant ant to threaten our settlement and spread another nest.
The chanting dragged on, the pheromone smoke stung my eyes, and none of it made the colony's supposed wisdom feel real.
LanguageData.VME_AwkwardInsectoidHymn.stages.0.label: awkward call of the colony
LanguageData.VME_AwkwardInsectoidHymn.stages.0.descri: The AntAgonizer lost the rhythm and repeated the same lesson until even the most faithful looked uncomfortable.
LanguageData.VME_RousingInsectoidHymn.stages.0.label: rousing call of the colony
LanguageData.VME_RousingInsectoidHymn.stages.0.descri: The AntAgonizer made the colony's discipline feel like something our settlement could truly share.
LanguageData.VME_EntrancingInsectoidHymn.stages.0.des: The rhythm, smoke, and answering clicks seemed to turn the entire settlement into one living colony.
